description: List the 62 available dataflow categories in the ADB Key Indicators Database (KIDB). Covers macroeconomic and social statistics for 50 Asia-Pacific economies. Dataflows are hierarchical topic groups: People (PPL), Economy and Output (EO), Money Finance and Prices (MFP), Government and Governance (GG), Globalization (GLB), Energy and Electricity (EGELC), Transport and Communication (TC), Environment and Climate Change (ENV), and Sustainable Development Goals (SDG_01–SDG_17). Use the returned code with adbkidb.indicators to discover indicator codes, then adbkidb.data to fetch actual values. Source: kidb.adb.org — Asian Development Bank open data, no auth required.

search.description: Optional keyword to filter dataflows by code or name (e.g. "gdp", "SDG", "EO_NA"). Leave empty to list all 62 dataflows.

name: adbkidb.explore.dataflows
